574-7084-7705.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a 1/1 green Minion creature token named Moloid with the listed attack trigger
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-7084-7705.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

240-5470-7175-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

4324-5107-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
4324-5107-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
4324-5107-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Workshop Elders.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

147-1854-2034.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1854-2034.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

967-3809-6495-6753-7087.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
967-3809-6495-6753-7087.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

997-7084-7889.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2447-5147-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2447-5147-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2447-5147-7124.notes: Either side of Infestation Expert can be used, but using Infested Werewolf nets infinite creature tokens.

2390-3310.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to an opponent.
2390-3310.description:
Any opponent takes damage.
The War Elemental triggers, putting a counter on a permanent.
All All Will Be One triggers, dealing at least 1 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

225-539-1362-1993.easyPrerequisites: You control nine or fewer lands.
225-539-1362-1993.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life by tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

2781-3169-7150.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and the Myr, copying Felidar Guardian's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Felidar Guardian's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 4.

240-1753-5470-6797.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2921-3534-7084.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control another nonland creature.
You control another nonland creature.
You control seven or more lands that have different names.
2921-3534-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
2921-3534-7084.notes: The land you earthbend can be Field of the Dead.

225-539-4249-6845.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 5.
225-539-4249-6845.description:
Activate Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}
Cast Spider-Byte by paying its mana cost.
When Spider-Byte enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Spider-Byte trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Repeat.
225-539-4249-6845.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.
Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.

539-4050-7037.description:
Cast Toph by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Toph
When Toph dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.

323-1497-5220-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

413-1445-4871-5632.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
413-1445-4871-5632.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

813-1987-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
813-1987-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

804-1479-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima the Impostor, and Arid Archway trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Arid Archway onto the battlefield.
Sakashima the Impostor and Arid Archway trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor token's trigger, putting Arid Archway onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Arid Archway trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

4798-5435-5631-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4798-5435-5631-5686.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a 2/2 Skeleton Pirate creature token.
Repeat.

24-220-4090.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Brash Taunter instead of you due to Pariah if you chose the largest number.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-220-4090.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

372-3742-4284.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying {3}{U}.
When Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Clone to return from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Phantom Steed.
When Clone enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Phantom Steed until Clone leaves the battlefield.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Clone and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Clone leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Phantom Steed to return to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

3310-4613-4968.notablePrerequisites: War Elemental has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3310-4613-4968.description:
Activate War Elemental using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
War Elemental triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat.

575-2789-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Voidmage Prodigy, adding {U}.
When Voidmage Prodigy dies, Yedora triggers, returning Voidmage Prodigy from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Voidmage Prodigy by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Voidmage Prodigy's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

824-2265-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Paradise Mantle attached to Leech Bonder.
824-2265-4474.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, and putting two +1/+1 counters on another target creature.
Repeat.

1656-3371-3995.manaNeeded: {4}, plus enough mana to pay for the nonland card's mana cost minus {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
1656-3371-3995.notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one nonland card in hand.
1656-3371-3995.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Codie's ability by paying {4} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Repeat as desired, skipping step 2 on the final iteration.
Cast any spell by paying its mana cost, reduced by the {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} added in step 1.
Necrotic Ooze triggers for each time you activated Codie's ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each nonland card in your hand as mana permits, and on subsequent turns.

3489-3542-3821.notablePrerequisites:
Peregrine Drake does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{B}.
3489-3542-3821.description:
Declare Peregrine Drake as an attacker.
When Peregrine Drake is unblocked, activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}.
Activate Palinchron's ninjitsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand, putting Palinchron from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{B}.
Activate Peregrine Drake's ninjitsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Palinchron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Peregrine Drake from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat from step 2.

628-3723-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Carnifex Demon.
When Carnifex Demon dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

1636-3000-4170-4419.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
A creature you control has a counter on it.
1636-3000-4170-4419.description:
Activate Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing a counter from a creature you control, creating a Treasure artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure and Squirrel tokens, you may activate Fain's other abilities.

uses.exileCardState: with a kick counter on it

126-249-1173.notablePrerequisites: Zethi does not have summoning sickness.
126-249-1173.description:
Declare Zethi as an attacker.
Zethi triggers, copying all cards you own in exile with kick counters on them and allowing you to cast the copies.
Cast the Final Fortune copy by paying {R}{R}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and lose the game at the end of the extra turn.
At the beginning of each extra turn's end step, Final Fortune triggers.
Holding priority, activate Obeka by tapping it, causing you to end your turn and exile Final Fortune's trigger from the stack.
Repeat each turn.

337-776-1237-1329.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Embraal Gear-Smasher do not have summoning sickness.
337-776-1237-1329.description:
Tap Embraal Gear-Smasher, sacrificing Fountain of Youth to deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Tap Emry, targeting Fountain of Youth.
Cast Fountain of Youth.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
